description: This Java interface defines configuration properties for a MessageMapper, including methods for retrieving properties, conditions, and content-type blocklists, as well as a builder interface for creating instances.

classes.name: MessageMapperConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for configuration properties of a MessageMapper, including methods for property retrieval, condition checks, and content-type blocklist handling.

classes.name: MessageMapperConfiguration.Builder
classes.description: Builder interface for constructing MessageMapperConfiguration instances with mutable property and condition maps.

methods.name: getPropertiesAsJson
methods.description: Converts configuration properties to a JSON object.

methods.name: findProperty
methods.description: Searches for a property by name and returns it as an Optional String.

methods.name: findProperty (generic)
methods.description: Searches for a property by name with type checking and casting, returning an Optional of the specified type.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a required property value or throws an exception if missing.

methods.name: getContentTypeBlocklist
methods.description: Returns a collection of content types that are blocked based on the configuration.
